rows.label: tlk45420151_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Blades born through resonance are
easily influenced by their Drivers'
hearts.

rows.label: tlk45420151_03_msg0002
rows.name:
I think it's best to use a Booster to
strengthen the strongest part of your
own heart even further.

rows.label: tlk45420151_03_msg0003
rows.name:
But when you want a Blade
with a different attribute,
try a different Booster.

rows.label: tlk45420151_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Of course, none of this makes it a
sure thing. At the end of the day,
the Blade you get is down to luck.
